art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Yasuo is an adult swordsman with dark hair in a high windswept ponytail, a short beard, a broad blue scarf, and one armored shoulder. His complete dark tunic, long sleeves, trousers, wraps, and sandals cover the body, with the curved sword securely sheathed at his waist and no drawn secondary blade.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: scarf blue, lilac pencil shadow, pale gold, weathered gray; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
